from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545726/attempts/1215c664ab1d474cb6ca911ca8ae1318/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import Counter\n\ndef transform(grid):\n    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]\n    out = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    for row in out:\n        i = len(row)\n        while i and row[i - 1] == background:\n            i -= 1\n        if i < len(row) and any(v != background for v in row[:i]):\n            row[i:] = [1] * (len(row) - i)\n    return out\n'''
p=programs/'task-233255ac.py'; p.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source,str(p),'exec'),globals())
